tasks.title: Thrust in a tilt while holding altitude
tasks.statement: A **{m} kg** aircraft holds altitude at a **{phi}°** bank. What total thrust is needed (N)?
tasks.solution: The vertical component of thrust T·cos φ must equal the weight m·g, so T = m·g / cos φ. At 60° that is already 2·m·g.

tasks.title: Radius of a coordinated turn
tasks.statement: Speed **{v} m/s**, bank **{phi}°**, altitude constant. Find the turn radius (m).
tasks.solution: The centripetal acceleration v²/r comes from the horizontal component of thrust: v²/r = g·tan φ, r = v²/(g·tan φ).

tasks.title: Drag at speed
tasks.statement: Frontal area **{a} m²**, C_d = **{cd}**, speed **{v} m/s**, ρ = 1.225 kg/m³. Find the drag force (N).
tasks.solution: D = ½·ρ·C_d·A·v². Drag grows with the square of speed: twice as fast means four times the force and eight times the power to overcome it.
